ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
is_abi3:
- false
is_python_min:
- false
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.14.* *_cp314t
python_min:
- '3.11'
rust_compiler:
- rust
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - is_python_min
  - channel_sources
  - is_abi3
name: pycrdt
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.14.6"
  python_check_max: "3.14"

package:
  name: pycrdt
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pycrdt/pycrdt-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ed59185cc0aec28d2fe2d92277a65af6ef799efcf5c5fe99303018cfc5d84428

build:
  number: 0
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win else ".sh" }}
      MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS: ${{ "--features pyo3/abi3" if is_abi3 else "" }}
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=1.8.2,<2
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - python-abi3
  run:
    - python
    - anyio >=4.4.0,<5.0.0
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-abi3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pycrdt
        - pycrdt._awareness
        - pycrdt._doc
        - pycrdt._text
        - pycrdt._array
        - pycrdt._map
        - pycrdt._transaction
        - pycrdt._undo
        - pycrdt._update
        - pycrdt._sync
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
          else:
            - "*"
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      site_packages:
        - pycrdt/**
        - pycrdt-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - abi3audit
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - cd "${{ '$SP_DIR' if unix else '%SP_DIR%' }}/pycrdt"
          - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} _pycrdt.${{ 'abi3.so' if unix else 'pyd' }}

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: CRDTs based on Yrs
  homepage: https://github.com/y-crdt/pycrdt
  repository: https://github.com/y-crdt/pycrdt
  documentation: https://y-crdt.github.io/pycrdt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - davidbrochart
